shell_command: dnx dotnet-inspect -y -- package query Microsoft.Azure.SignalR --where "library-literal=https://" --tfm net8.0 -S "Literal Strings" --json

interpretation.package_selection: Microsoft.Azure.SignalR is an exact package ID, not a prefix pattern. Without a pinned version, package query selects the latest eligible listed version; no version or result was verified.
interpretation.literal_match: The equals sign supplies the library-literal operand. The registered operation is an ordinal substring search over each decoded string-literal use, so a use containing https:// matches even when the whole literal is longer. Ordinal matching preserves case.
interpretation.library_scope: The filter downloads the package and searches the selected implementation libraries for the exact net8.0 target framework context. This is not a source-text or reference-assembly search claim.

normalization_and_repeat_rules.normalization: Preserve the operand exactly, including whitespace, newlines, and case; do not normalize.
normalization_and_repeat_rules.repetition: Identical repeated library-literal operands collapse to one distinct value; distinct operands are incompatible.

framework_context_supply: Supply library-target with --tfm net8.0, not a --where term. The binding requires library-literal and --tfm together and says to use one exact NuGet target framework.
empty_values_interpretation: The library-literal values array is empty, but the facet explicitly says any decoded UTF-16 text satisfying the registered constraints is accepted; it is not an allow list. Empty lists or unregistered rules alone would not establish unrestricted acceptance.

evidence_scope.selection_rationale: The shipped root skill gives this exact section for the library-literal production command. Selecting it requests literal evidence; no -n, --rows, --columns, or --fields truncates or projects occurrences.
evidence_scope.registered_route: Package Query returns one completed package-grain document with matches, failures, and completion summary. The selected section is a presentation projection, so no claim is made that it retains the entire unselected document or service diagnostics.
evidence_scope.actual_results: Unknown: the package query was deliberately not executed.

issued_path_href_provenance.source: response-01.out similarity result resource_path; also response-04.out Packages facet resource_path

uncertainties: The specific package version, whether the package has any matching implementation libraries or string-literal uses, result count, failures, and completion status are unknown because the query was not run.
The library-target facet has no registered input_rules of its own. Do not infer additional target-framework acceptance or fallback behavior beyond its summary and the CLI binding.

The selected Literal Strings JSON schema and whether it includes completion diagnostics are not registered in the inspected explanations; the complete unselected package-query document is separately described.
failures: No product request failed. Two discovery requests were accidentally issued concurrently against a sequential trial recorder; both receipts named response-02.out, and response-02.out held the CLI binding. The facet request was rerun sequentially as response-03.out, with no information inferred from the overwritten file.
rationale_for_extra_fetches: response-02.out CLI binding: confirm syntax, JSON flag, and required framework context.
response-04.out -Q Packages: verify library-literal is a registered Package Query facet and inspect its example and execution class.
response-05.out route and response-06.out document: determine result grain and evidence/completion scope.
response-07.out required-context href: check the exact library-target record and avoid inventing unregistered rules.
